title: Expedition Complete
text: Marrow walks the drone back to the gate herself. Before it goes she says one more thing, quietly, so her people won't hear: "There's a signal on Dunmore. Under the sand. I've had it a year and never had the escort to go and look. Think about it." Dunmore is on the routes now.

choices.label: Return to Touchdown
choices.reply: The lander lifts. On the wall, Marrow watches it all the way up.

choices.label: Stay a while
choices.reply: The expedition stays. The Command Core's card lists every route, home included, for when we're ready.

notes: onDone of landfall. The Act 2 "Expedition complete" card: Return to Touchdown travels home; Stay keeps playing here (the Command Core lists every route).
